Class QueueFIFO<T>

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.QueueFIFO<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of T in the queue
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
public class QueueFIFO<T> extends SysMLAttributeType
SysMLinJava representation of a first-in-first-out queue as a SysML value type. It uses/implements the jave Deque interface and extends the SysMLAttributeType to provide a familiar queue construct that can be used as an attribute in an item or part.

As an extension of the SysMLAttributeType, the QueueFIFO can be used for constraint parameters in parametric analysis. It can alse by used as attributes in items and parts. SysMLinJava includes other value types for collections such as the KeyValueMap and List

    • createUnits

      protected void createUnits()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
